scope: P2 essential-service data explanation and account-synced optional improvement telemetry consent.
implemented: Security settings explain required account, security, routing and abuse-prevention processing without presenting a fake disable switch.
The explanation points users to the real session, disable-account and delete-account controls on the same page.
Optional improvement telemetry is off unless the signed-in account explicitly opts in.
The preference is server-validated, account-synced and retained by the client preference cache/retry pipeline.
Screen-share sender and receiver performance events use the consent gate; operational security and failure diagnostics remain separate.
Permitted optional events carry an explicit optional-improvement classification.
remaining: Verify persistence and cross-device behavior with two independent signed-in clients.
Review every future product-improvement event to ensure it uses the optional gate rather than the operational logger.
Installed Windows visual and interaction acceptance remains open.
release: Source and automated fixtures only; no commit, push, merge, deployment or Windows update was performed.
